in_marathi.name: Bhagirath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of salvation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagirath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhagirath was a sage who brought salvation to his ancestors by pleading with Lord Brahma to release the Ganges from the heavens so that their souls could be purified and reach moksha.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bringer of salvation
